'''Kallyx the Piner''' was a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] operating during the time leading up to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
A corrupt [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], Kallyx was known as the Piner, an ancient word meaning "to torture." Taking a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Tobar Ka-Teen/Legends|Tobar Ka-Teen]] posted by [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]], Ka-Teen successfully captured the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]]. Torturing him for [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] using [[Knife/Legends|knives]], Ka-Teen successfully manipulated Kallyx, deceiving her through a complex web of lies. Kallyx's torture ended when a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] strike force rescued Ka-Teen.<ref name="NoP" />
